about: Veridact verifier conformance vectors for specification v0.5 (SD-JWT VC, Token Status List, HTTPS identifiers). Every case runs at 'now', with 'nonce' issued by the relying party and unused. 'kind' says which verification to run. 'code' is normative; 'reason' is the reference library's internal code and is informative. 'request.risk' defaults to medium.
